answer: Each work unit is a pearl: whole or worthless. An identity posts a 70-credit bond and submits one complete pearl per epoch; the pearl makes its voyage through two gates, and the kernel template lists every required part in public. A split pearl is rejected and the bond burns, so one piece of work cannot be sliced into many fake claims. The k-th fake needs its own 70 bond plus one complete unit, so 1,000 fakes lock 70,000 and must produce 1,000 complete units. An honest agent posts one bond and one unit. A work-splitting ring fails because fragments never match the kernel template.
